basic_details.job_title: OAV Malkangiri Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 5 Assistant Cook, Warden and More Posts
basic_details.organization_name: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Jhulunibahal, Mathili, Malkangiri
basic_details.short_information: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Jhulunibahal, Mathili, Malkangiri (OAV Malkangiri) has announced a total of 5 contract vacancies for Warden — 1, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper — 1, Head Cook — 1, and Assistant Cook — 2 posts. Eligible applicants can apply offline by downloading the form, filling it in capital letters, attaching self-attested document copies, and sending it by Speed Post to the Principal of OAV, Jhulunibahal from 1 October 2026 until the last date of 31 October 2026. The notified pay is Rs. 21,175 for Warden, Rs. 7,500 for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Rs. 9,000 for Head Cook, and Rs. 6,750 for Assi

application_fee.details: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification.

age_limit.details: Warden: 30 to 60 years Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: 21 to 32 years Head Cook: 30 to 40 years Assistant Cook: 21 to 32 years

qualification.details: Warden: BA/BSc from any recognized University with at least 02 years experience in hostel management. Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper: HSC Examination. Head Cook: Trained in cookery preferred. Assistant Cook: Trained in cookery preferred.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Malkangiri Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://malkangiri.odisha.gov.in.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 31-10-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Jhulunibahal, Mathili, Malkangiri (OAV Malkangiri) is conducting this recruitment drive for various contract positions.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available under OAV Malkangiri Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Warden, Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper, Head Cook, and Assistant Cook across different categories.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies available for various posts under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their applications through offline mode via Speed Post only.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form is 31 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification required for the Warden post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Warden post must possess a BA/BSc degree from a recognized university along with at least 2 years of experience in hostel management.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post is between 21 and 32 years as on the date of advertisement.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Warden post will receive a salary of Rs. 21,175/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. Where should the completed application form be sent?
faq.answer: The filled application form along with required documents should be sent by Speed Post to the Principal of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Jhulunibahal, Malkangiri.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for submitting the application form.
